Bhaṅgo.g: aladdhaṁ uppādetuṁ na sakkoti laddhaṁ samāpajjituṁ.
tesaṁ nibbattadhammānaṁ bhaṅgo nāma purato eva kato, ekaṁsabhāvī na apasakkatīti attho.

bhaṅgo.g: brahmacariyavāso nāma dukkaro, anabhiratassa brahmacariyassa ce bhaṅgo hoti, tadā gihibhūtassa bhogehi kāriyaṁ hoti, evarūpe kāle tvaṁ nirāsaṅko hutvā mama santikaṁ āgaccheyyāsi, bahuṁ te dhanaṁ dassāmīti.

bhaṅgakkhaṇena.g: vadantena kiriyakhandhānaṁ bhaṅgakkhaṇena saha upapattesiyā khandhā uppajjantīti ca vattabbaṁ, tathā upapattesiyānaṁ bhaṅgakkhaṇena saha upapattesiyā, kiriyānaṁ bhaṅgakkhaṇena saha kiriyāti.

bhaṅgakkhaṇe.l: Sabbesaṁ cavantānaṁ pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe āruppe maggassa ca phalassa ca uppādakkhaṇe tesaṁ samudayasaccañca nuppajjati dukkhasaccañca nuppajjatī
bhaṅgakkhaṇe.g: etthapana “pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe dukkhasaccaṁ nuppajjatī”ti cittapaṭibaddhavuttittā cittajarūpameva idhādhippetaṁ, na kammajādirūpaṁ cittaṁ anapekkhitvāva uppajjanatoti keci vadanti.
āgataṭṭhāne paṭisandhicittassapi bhaṅgakkhaṇaggahaṇaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, tathā “pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe”ti āgataṭṭhāne ca cuticittassapi uppādakkhaṇassāti.
pana bhijjamānacittasamaṅgī puggalo vutto, tassa atītaṁ cittaṁ uppajjittha, na ca kiñci cittaṁ uppajjati.

bhaṅgakkhaṇe.l: Pañcavokāre akusalānaṁ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṁ akusalā ca dhammā nirujjhanti abyākatā ca dhammā nirujjhantī
bhaṅgakkhaṇe.g: vacanena paṭisandhicittato soḷasamaṁ, tato parampi vā bhavanikanticittaṁ hoti, na tato oranti viññāyatīti.

bhaṅgakkhaṇa.g: āgataṭṭhāne paṭisandhicittassapi bhaṅgakkhaṇaggahaṇaṁ daṭṭhabbaṁ, tathā “pavatte cittassa uppādakkhaṇe”ti āgataṭṭhāne ca cuticittassapi uppādakkhaṇassāti.
pana bhijjamānacittasamaṅgī puggalo vutto, tassa atītaṁ cittaṁ uppajjittha, na ca kiñci cittaṁ uppajjati.

bhaṅgakkhaṇe,.l: cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe, nirodhasamāpannānaṁ, asaññasattānaṁ tesaṁ cittaṁ uppajjittha no ca tesaṁ cittaṁ uppajjatī
bhaṅgakkhaṇe,.g: ettha “cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṁ cittaṁ uppajjitthā”ti etassa “sabbesaṁ cittaṁ khaṇapaccuppannameva hutvā uppādakkhaṇaṁ atītattā uppajjittha nāmā”ti attho vutto.

bhaṅgakkhaṇe,.l: sabbesaṁ cavantānaṁ, pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe, āruppe akusalānaṁ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṁ kusalā ca dhammā na uppajjanti abyākatā ca dhammā na uppajjantī
bhaṅgakkhaṇe,.g: ettha pavatte cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe uppajjamānampi kammasamuṭṭhānādirūpaṁ1 aggahetvā “abyākatā ca dhammā na uppajjantī”ti vuttattā cittasamuṭṭhānarūpameva idhādhippetaṁ.

Bhaṅgānupassane.g: yo tadārammaṇassa cittassa bhaṅgo, tassa anupassane.
tassa ārammaṇaṁ bhaṅgato paṭisaṅkhāya uppannassa ñāṇassa bhaṅgaṁ anupassane yā paññā, taṁ “vipassane ñāṇan”ti vuttaṁ hoti.
tassa, ārammaṇaṁ khayato vayato paṭisaṅkhāya uppannassa ñāṇassa bhaṅgaṁ anupassane yā paññā, idaṁ vipassane ñāṇanti vuttaṁ.

Bhaṅgānupassana.g: yo tadārammaṇassa cittassa bhaṅgo, tassa anupassane.

bhaṅgaṁ.g: yena cittena taṁ rūpārammaṇaṁ khayato vayato diṭṭhaṁ, tassa cittassa aparena cittena bhaṅgaṁ anupassatīti attho.

bhaṅgā.g: kati anusayā anusenti nānusentīti evaṁ vibhajitabbāti attho.
yassa hi yo anuseti, so anusetiyeva.

bhaṅga.g: brahmacariyavāso nāma dukkaro, anabhiratassa brahmacariyassa ce bhaṅgo hoti, tadā gihibhūtassa bhogehi kāriyaṁ hoti, evarūpe kāle tvaṁ nirāsaṅko hutvā mama santikaṁ āgaccheyyāsi, bahuṁ te dhanaṁ dassāmīti.
